Warframe may seem boring because of all the grinding required, the long waits, and the mastery being required for so many weapons. Set all of the above aside. The mechanics of movement on this game are so smooth, the weapons amazing, and the overall storyline, or lines if you'd prefer, are beyond Awesome. I started playing about 2 years ago, and sometimes you gotta take a little brake, but in the end. You will eventually want to come back. The whole grinding deal means constantly running missions, you'll burn yourself out in about 3 weeks. You'll stop playing. Wait 2 weeks, open it again, notice the 10 MB update in the launcher, and see they released a new patch. You'll then play until your burnt out again. Thats another thing, in the 5 years this game has been available, they are constantly updating, patching, increasing the content. and if you buy platinum. I have to say this, it won't last. There's just so much to do, you won't want to grind out for the new weapon, and you'll probably go ahead and buy it. but it is worth it. despite what everyone says. They also say it's pay to win. That is not true. If you learn the Trading system you'll unlock a whole world of doors. It won't matter wether you pay a dime. because you can make the platinum you get through payment, through trading. want to get that 20 plat character slot. Sell a rare mod you don't use. Its a completely fair game. and while gear determines the victor. You can't expect to walk into a warzone with shoes and a shirt and walk out with a tank and 3 grenade launchers without getting dirty. same applys, you'll have to put in effort, and time. but this is well worth both. despite what they say.
Space Ninjas. Ninjas, in Space. What the heck else do you want? (also like 1000+ hours of gameplay and a grind that's worse than Monster Hunter, but that's irrelevant.)
singleplayer-not that bad multiplayer-the worst thing in the world
